# StyleBook

> StyleBook 1.2.0 is a local-first visual reference library for AI workflows, built by EmaF205.

Canonical site: https://brera-stylebook.netlify.app/
Guide: https://brera-stylebook.netlify.app/guide/
Purchase: https://emaf205.gumroad.com/l/brera-stylebook
Author: https://it.linkedin.com/in/emanuelebdc/

## Verified product facts

- Current version: 1.2.0
- Local image upload and drag-and-drop
- PNG, JPEG, WEBP and GIF support
- One-click image copy to clipboard
- Custom categories
- Search and Favorites
- 3-column, 5-column and list views
- Editable titles and categories
- Local browser storage
- JSON backup export
- Restore using Merge or Replace
- 9 starter references: 5 STYLES + 4 UX
- Safe migration from untouched v1.1 starter data without overwriting user-created libraries
- Self-contained exported backups for embedded starter references
- Delivered as a ZIP with START-HERE, complete product guide, README, changelog and licence

## Positioning

StyleBook is a personal visual reference library. It is not presented as a cloud collaboration platform, image generator, AI tagging engine or general file manager.
